description: Shared test vectors of PASSKEY-PROTOCOL.md section 13.10. Binary values are base64url without padding; times are YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; texts are UTF-8 strings. A result is 'ok' or the error value of the specification; a bundle result is 'ok', 'check_2:<error of verify_certificate>' or 'check_<n>' for device checks 3 to 6 of section 9. 'signatures' lists the ECDSA signatures the generator reuses, because ECDSA signing is randomized; it is not a vector.
